reviews.classification: full user-pasted historical response with missing citation identity preserved
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual175-line read preserves the user-supplied recovered response after a rendering failure. The five ranked donors, fourteen-candidate table with missing cells/names, authoring map, archive routes, five combinations and five research questions are the pasted response, not independently verified primary-source research. Bare GitHub/+n placeholders and missing URLs cannot supply reproducible citations; do not silently reconstruct the unnamed candidates. Current source/release/install state was not checked. The actual later scout/expansion/acquisition owners and B216/B497 qualify its initial no-download/render-failure states.

F2: Preserve SevTech's question about hidden existence versus known interpretation/eligibility; E6's guidance versus actual support; Create's retained workpiece/ordered operations/byproducts and contextual teaching; Hex's typed composition/failure versus ordinary nonprogrammer play; GTNH's possession/consumption/execution/provenance distinction. These are bounded donor questions, not a demonstration that the current game lacks each consumer or a new five-donor cap/build order. A missing-support explanation can accept trade, service, investigation or local production through actual means. Legitimate prior work need not be erased for failing tutorial order.

F3: Quest parent/visibility/task/reward flags, minimum dependencies, optional branches, repeat cooldowns, flexible task progress, guide entries and real recipe/event scripts have different authority. A retrieval flag or ignoreNBT does not prove manufacture, original ownership or meaningful execution. A source ZIP, pack export overrides and mrpack remote manifest are different payloads; none establishes executable parity, fully present dependencies or tested dynamic predicates. KubeJS/CraftTweaker/Patchouli/FTB/BetterQuesting are authoring references, not proposed YAIR runtime dependencies. Pin chosen versions rather than merge Minecraft editions, Tinkers generations, Thaumcraft variants or expert-pack recipes.

F4: Intermediate identity is useful where it changes later choice, custody or recovery, not a mandate to retain every routine step. The response's retired first-realm milestone, fixed no-programming/anti-recursion limits, lossless recovery implication and punitive-expense comparisons remain proposals read through AD5/AD38/AD51/AD52. Actual stronger effects, irreversible source-defined stages or physical topology may be appropriate when their mechanism matters. Independent explanation/learning/procurement, actual item conservation and useful paid result remain valuable without forcing one pack's stage ladder. License statements are dated/incomplete observations, not fresh copying authority or a bar to local source inspection. No source/game/archive/library/runtime was changed or executed.

reviews.classification: full two-round dated desk scout with corrected scope and recommendation
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual190-line review reads F1–F34, E1–E10, O1–O12, D1–D8, A1–A6, M1–M6 and both verification/limits sections. Dense truncation recovered65–77,77–112 and113–133 before credit. The report's own Round2 corrects the initial shonen/action bias, separates source-community development projects and supersedes O1-first with O6/O7 then O8. Preserve this correction;34entry desk screen is not34played games, newest-release ranking or present availability. Current titles, place/creator IDs, active/remade/discontinued status and press-release dates remain2026-10-26 attributed evidence. This reconciliation performs no fresh web or source-game verification.

F2: F10/F11 are distinct Re:Zero incrementals, F15/F16/F17 distinct RI projects, F19 distinct from Bizarre Lineage, and renamed/redirected/stasis entries retain uncertainty. Self-identified author plans, opened platform descriptions, indexed-only titles, fan guides/mirrors, unviewed trailers and source-code seams differ. A franchise name does not demonstrate predator analysis, unique law, custom Nen, inner-world simulation or source fidelity. Advertised counts/rarities/branching/abilities/Gu are not tested semantic coverage, and bounded failed searches for other adaptations are not proof of absence.

F3: O6/M1 retain a maintained functional power with real food/supply, owner/custody, condition, energy and useful consumer, including actual shortage/recovery and qualified clock. Do not import a real24hour punishment, forced aging, daily penalty or universal upkeep. O7/M2 preserve component function, timing/control, substitution and interrupted settlement; use count differs from understanding, formula knowledge or canon attainment. Current AD51 permits a justified shared first seam then later validation, qualifying O7's second-consumer wording. Existing E7/E8 descriptors are inputs, not a playable Gu ecology/refinement/composition loop. Source-specific upkeep belongs to the chosen world, not every learned ability.

F4: O8/M3 distinguish new life, retry, world rewind and retained knowledge/aptitude/body/baggage; a local module refusing retained-world rewind is a scoped current boundary, not metaphysical prohibition. O9/M4 ordeal deeds, coherent outcome, drawbacks and actual next use differ from a score/rarity meter. O10/M5 generation differs from a preset list and requires actual different function, stable identity and valid unsupported-case handling. O11/O12/M6 distinguish body/senses/needs, power source, equipment, learned control, institutional credential and career; no single rank should supply them all. These are proposed authoring/evidence questions, not a new mandatory drawback, fixed power limit or global equalization rule.

F5: E1–E10's dated file/import inspection suggests reuse of existing vow/structured-ability/technique/gate/trial/continuation/resource/making/codex/scenario/body owners. Presence is neither full native behavior nor source canon. Original book owners and current Klein/HP build order govern selected work; this research reopening did not choose a new anime world or revive all saved references as automatic build dispatch. Keep the broader candidate palette and useful social/career/embodiment distinctions without forcing a roster system, reflex minigame, universal rarity ladder or multiplayer scarcity rule. AD36/AD42/AD43/AD51/AD52 govern selected verification and current human optional review. No fresh browser/client, source body, download, runtime edit, spending, worker, private save, deletion, commit or push occurred.
